description: Defines the AppState class for managing application state related to lesson progress and quiz scores, extending ChangeNotifier for state change notifications.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A state management class that tracks lesson progress and quiz scores, providing methods to update these while notifying listeners.

methods.name: updateLessonProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress percentage for a given lesson and notifies listeners.

methods.name: saveQuizScore
methods.description: Stores the quiz score for a specific quiz and triggers a notification to listeners.
